summary.zh: 用 uv 管理 Python 依赖和虚拟环境
summary.en: Manage Python dependencies and environments with uv

description.zh: 用 uv 安装依赖、创建虚拟环境、锁定版本并统一项目工作流，速度明显快于传统工具。适合新建 Python 项目，或想简化现有项目的依赖管理。需要本机已安装 uv。
description.en: Uses uv to install dependencies, create virtual environments, lock versions, and keep project workflows consistent. Good for new Python projects or simplifying existing setups. Requires uv installed locally.
